AC-000003.assertion: Nari is a low-status but skilled apprentice sky-reader.

AC-000011.assertion: Master Orem recognizes danger through inherited warning, office, and fear.

AC-000016.assertion: Master Orem has spent a lifetime within an inherited explanatory order that has repeatedly proven useful and meaningful. Age, accumulated experience, responsibility, identity, and fear make him increasingly resistant to evidence that threatens those established truths. His rigidity is not simple ignorance; it is the hardened form of caution and fear.

provenance.note: Revised during Canon consolidation to emphasize age, accumulated experience, and fear rather than simple dogmatism.

AC-000017.assertion: Nari’s youth leaves her less invested in inherited explanations. Her curiosity and attention to repeated evidence make her willing to question established truths when observation contradicts them. She feels genuine fear, but curiosity presently outweighs it; her strength is willingness to revise rather than certainty that she understands.

provenance.note: Revised during Canon consolidation to establish youthful curiosity, genuine fear, and epistemic humility.
